instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Include the Google Fonts link in the main index.html. Extend Tailwind config with 'Playfair Display' for serif and 'Outfit' for sans.
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_components: Use simple custom HTML/Tailwind for structural components since it's a marketing landing page. For icons, use lucide-react. Include map iframe or link for Google Maps integration.
sections: Header: Brand name left, CTA (WhatsApp) right. Sticky top.
Hero: High impact with background image (overlay white/20 to ensure text readability), big Serif H1, main WhatsApp CTA (#25D366) and Location details visible clearly.
Services: Card-based grid (3 cards). Use pink/rose colored icons (lucide-react). Title and short description.
Our Collection (Gallery): A grid showing 8-9 beautiful ethnic wear images. Use object-cover and rounded corners.
About Owner: Two-column layout on desktop (Image of Munna Idresy + 35 years experience bio).
Footer: Contact numbers, Instagram link, Google map embed/link to exact location, simple clean bottom.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testids: Ensure all interactive elements and sections have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="whatsapp-cta", data-testid="instagram-link").
